decisions.reason: Although the Magento shop template is related to the firm's shop-project know-how, it is peripheral to the higher-value hosting and support core, and its later absence from the website suggests limited learning returns relative to the resources needed to keep it current.

The responsive website template fits existing web and CMS knowledge, but as a relatively standardized add-on that was no longer visible later, it is a plausible candidate to be discontinued in favor of the firm's more central platform and service development.

Premium customer support draws directly on the firm's strongest existing capabilities in expert operations, customer service, and continuous improvement, so absorptive capacity for this offer remains very high.
Scalable hosting for agencies is tightly aligned with the firm's core infrastructure, R&D, and agency-focused strategy and was presented as a flagship line, making continued retention highly likely.
